correctness.rationale: Exact mod-two elimination gives rank(d2)=40 and rank(d3)=39 on 80 triangles, so ambient H2 has dimension one. Every vertex subset through size six is exhaustively processed through its complete local 2-cycle space and reduction modulo global tetrahedral boundaries. The support counts are 0,0,0,0,0,20 for sizes one through six. Every minimizer has induced f=(6,15,10), no tetrahedra, edge degree two, and cyclic vertex links, hence is a connected closed surface of Euler characteristic one and therefore RP2. Independent finite backtracking finds exactly 48 simplicial automorphisms and carrier orbits of sizes 12 and 8.

value.rationale: RP3 is the basic nonorientable-in-codimension-one mod-two example, and the six-vertex RP2 is the vertex-minimal triangulation of its natural dual surface. The theorem shows that the vertex-minimal eleven-vertex RP3 contains exactly twenty induced minimal RP2 representatives of its nonzero mod-two H2 class, organized into only two symmetry types. This is a structural carrier theorem, not a routine Betti-number recomputation.
